test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 24

questions.question: In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)(52, 24)(28, 12)
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order? BEF, YBC, VYZ, SVW, ?

In this question two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.Statements:I) The Director of institution Y issued show cause notices to some of the employees.II) Some of the employees of institution Y were found to be involved in offensive activities.
options: Both statements I and II are effects of independent causes.
Both the statements I and II are independent causes.
Statement I is the cause and statement II is its possible effect.
Statement II is the cause and statement I is its possible effect.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Statement II is the cause and statement I is its possible effect.) है।

Geeta starts from Point P and drives 6 km towards the south. Then she takes a right turn, drives 8 km, she turns right again and drives 10 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. Then she takes left turn and drives 2 km, she takes a left turn again and drives 4 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point P again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (6 km towards south) है।

questions.question: Param ranked 19th from the top and 12th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?

इस प्रश्न में दो कथन I और II दिए गए हैं। ये कथन स्वतंत्र कारण या स्वतंत्र कारणों के प्रभाव या एक उभयनिष्ठ कारण हो सकते हैं। इनमें से एक कथन दूसरे कथन का प्रभाव हो सकता है। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प चुनिए।

कथन:
I) शहर X की पुलिस ने हाल ही में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में रात के समय गश्त बढ़ा दी है।
II) शहर X में चोरों और गुंडों के बारे में पुलिस थानों में काफी शिकायतें दर्ज की गई हैं।
options: कथन I कारण है और कथन II इसका संभावित प्रभाव है।
कथन I और II दोनों स्वतंत्र कारण हैं।
कथन I और II दोनों स्वतंत्र कारणों के प्रभाव हैं।
कथन II कारण है और कथन I इसका संभावित प्रभाव है।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (कथन II कारण है और कथन I इसका संभावित प्रभाव है।) है।
